findings.description: The cover title 海洋变暖与南极海冰骤减 is far too large for the card. It runs past the card's right edge and yellow shadow onto the purple background, the big yellow Aa circle covers part of it, and the right screen edge cuts off the rest. Only 海洋变暖与 is fully readable: 南 is half covered, 极 is hidden behind the circle, 海 is cut at x≈1920, and 冰骤减 is completely off screen. The title should fit on one line inside the white card. The other cover text matches the reference: 中考英语 · 阅读理解, 中考英语 2026年 北京 · 阅读C, 说明文 · 自然与环境, and 全文 348 词 (348 words, verified).

The vocabulary panel font is abnormally large, roughly twice the size used on other screens, and the 11 entries overflow the panel at both ends. Entries 1 (researcher) and 2 (input…into) are pushed above the screen and not visible at all. Entry 3 (recorded adj. 记录下来的) sits on top of the purple header band and the VOCABULARY tag: its badge '3' and 'adj.' are drawn inside the header, and the purple headword covers the header text '2026年 北京 · 阅读C 海洋变暖与南极海冰骤减', which now looks broken. Entry 8 (sea ice 海冰) crosses the panel's bottom border and the footer progress bar. Entry 9 (grow 增长) is cut off at the bottom of the screen, and entries 10 (as) and 11 (real world) are off screen. The English shows circles 1–11, but the panel shows only 4–8 cleanly (3 and 9 partly), so the two sets do not match. The footer SENTENCE 14 / 17 and the progress bar are correct.

The English sentence 'Some research has suggested that higher air temperatures may be the cause.' is set in an abnormally large font, about 1.6× the size on the other screens, and it starts too high. The first line 'Some research¹ has' runs into the purple header band and over the thin yellow rule under it (tops of the letters at y≈90, the rule at y≈108). The text should stay inside the content area below the header and use a normal size.

The Chinese translation is also oversized. Its second line 升高。 runs into the footer and is printed right over the label 'SENTENCE 3 / 17', so the sentence counter can't be read. The pink bar also reaches down into the footer. The progress bar position is correct (3/17).

In the Chinese translation the character 洲 is missing and a replacement-character box (a black box with a '?') appears in its place. The screen reads '南极�四周环绕着一条由强风和风暴构成的地带。' but the reference has '南极洲四周环绕着一条由强风和风暴构成的地带。'. The panel entry 'Antarctica n. 南极洲' on the same screen renders 洲 correctly.

The first English line 'These winds blow¹' does not start at the left margin. It begins at x≈610 instead of x≈90, leaving a blank gap of about 520 px at the start of the line. The second line 'surface water² and ice forward³.' starts at the normal left margin, so the paragraph looks right-aligned on line 1 only. Both lines should start flush left like every other screen.

verdicts.why: Screen 1: the title 海洋变暖与南极海冰骤减 is far too large. Only 海洋变暖与 is fully readable. 南 runs past the card edge and is partly hidden by the yellow Aa circle. A fragment of the next character shows at x≈1830–1920 and is cut off by the screen edge, and the rest of the title is off screen. The other cover text matches the reference.

Screen 15 (sentence 14): the vocabulary panel font is roughly double the normal size. Entries 1–2 are not visible. Entry 3's badge '3' and 'adj.' sit inside the purple header, the header text '2026年 北京 · 阅读C 海洋变暖…' is partly wiped out, and 记录下来的 overlaps the VOCABULARY tag. Entry 8 (sea ice 海冰) crosses the panel border and the progress bar. Entry 9 is cut off at the bottom of the screen, and entries 10–11 are missing, while the English shows badges 1–11.
Screen 4: the English sentence is set much larger than on the other screens. The first line 'Some research¹ has' starts at y≈90, overlapping the header band and the yellow rule at y≈108.

Screen 4: the Chinese translation is oversized. Its second line 升高。 is printed over 'SENTENCE 3 / 17' in the footer, which makes the counter unreadable, and the pink bar runs down into the footer. The progress knob (x≈560) is in the correct position for 3/17.

Zooming in on screen 8 confirms a dark replacement box with a '?' between 南极 and 四周 where 洲 should be. The reference has 南极洲四周环绕着…. On the same screen, 洲 renders correctly in the panel entry 'Antarctica n. 南极洲'.

Screen 12: the first line 'These winds blow¹' starts at x≈610, while the second line 'surface water² and ice forward³.' and the English on every other screen start at x≈90. This leaves a large blank gap at the start of line 1.

notes:

(c) The footer reads "SENTENCE 6 / 17" with no PART label, which is correct because sentence 6 is not split. The progress knob is at x≈804, between the knobs on screen06 (≈722) and screen08 (≈886). That is about 82 px per sentence, which matches 1389/17, so the bar matches 6/17.

Nothing is cut off or overlapping, and there are no tofu boxes, garbled characters or odd gaps. The full-width punctuation in the panel (；（海）) is rendered compactly as designed. The English and Chinese font sizes match screen06.
One observation, not reported as a defect: the gloss "(融化)" wraps to the start of line 6, apart from "melt" at the end of line 5. The gloss itself is not broken, and it would not fit on line 5, so this is a normal wrap at a space. Screens opened: 07, 06 and 08.

Every panel headword, POS and meaning matches the reference: scientist n. 科学家 / lead v. 带领；率领 / more than 多于；超过 / trip n. 行程；旅行 / mountain n. 山；高山 / even adv. 甚至 / age n. 年龄；年纪 / get hurt 受伤 / badly adv. 严重地；厉害地 / fall v. 摔下；跌落 / back n. 背部 / horse n. 马 / during prep. 在……期间.
